key.name: history-size
key.description: Maximum number of clipboard history entries to maintain.

key.name: enable-monitoring
key.description: Whether to actively monitor the system clipboard for changes.

key.name: close-after-copy
key.description: Automatically close the clipboard indicator popup menu after selecting an entry to copy.

key.name: show-timestamps
key.description: Display relative or absolute timestamps for each clipboard history entry.

key.name: enable-deduplication
key.description: Filter out duplicate items when new clipboard contents match existing entries.

key.name: popup-height
key.description: Maximum height of the clipboard popup menu in pixels.

key.name: theme-mode
key.description: Color theme mode for the extension interface (dark).

key.name: display-density
key.description: Layout density of clipboard history items (compact or comfortable).

key.name: show-indicator-label
key.description: Show a text label next to the panel indicator icon.

key.name: preview-lines
key.description: Number of lines to show in preview for text entries.

key.name: toggle-popup
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open or close the clipboard history popup menu.

key.name: focus-search
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to focus the search input field in the popup menu.

key.name: toggle-pinned
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to filter and display pinned clipboard items only.

key.name: clear-history
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to clear all non-pinned clipboard history entries.

key.name: enable-persistence
key.description: Persist clipboard history across GNOME Shell and system sessions.

key.name: retention-days
key.description: Number of days to retain clipboard history entries before automatic pruning.

key.name: persist-images
key.description: Persist image entries to disk along with text history.

key.name: detect-sensitive
key.description: Detect sensitive data (e.g., passwords, API keys, tokens, credit card numbers) and apply privacy protections.

key.name: max-image-storage-mb
key.description: Maximum disk storage in megabytes allocated for cached clipboard images.

key.name: enable-ocr
key.description: Enable optical character recognition to extract and index searchable text from clipboard images.

key.name: enable-collections
key.description: Enable organizing clipboard history entries into custom collections or tags.

key.name: enable-dev-tools
key.description: Enable developer tools including clipboard inspector, format viewers, and debugging utilities.

key.name: enable-similarity
key.description: Enable fuzzy similarity detection between clipboard entries to detect near-duplicates.
